subject: Re: AtlasMed — Private deployment commercial structure and SRE tiering
messages:
From: Susan Huang <susan.huang@atlasmed.com>
To: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement@atlasmed.com
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Initial RFI + questions on private deployment pricing

Hi Rishi,

Thanks for the demo last week — the team was impressed with the latency and observability. Procurement asked me to kick off an RFI thread so we can capture commercial preferences for a private VPC/on‑prem deployment. High level asks:

- We need a clear breakdown: one‑time license vs. recurring platform fee vs. SRE retainer.
- Typical amortization windows you offer (24, 36, 48 months) and how the platform fee can be staggered.
- Pricing sensitivity: what discounts are realistic at a $1.2M ARR commit (first 12 months) vs. $2.5M?
- Can you provide SOC2 evidence (PDF is fine) and a short list of included support response SLAs for each tier?

I've attached our RFI doc with specific compliance questions (AtlasMed_RFI_SOC2.pdf).

Could you loop in pricing and ops folks? We are aiming to lock preliminary terms this quarter.

Regards,
Susan Huang
Director, Procurement
AtlasMed

Attachment: AtlasMed_RFI_SOC2.pdf (application/pdf, 420KB)

From: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
To: Susan Huang <susan.huang@atlasmed.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, irene_choi@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 13:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Initial RFI + questions on private deployment pricing

Susan — thanks for the clear list. Looping in Marissa (commercial) and Irene (deployments & SRE) to get precise numbers and the SOC2 bundle. Quick notes while they prepare:

- We typically split commercial into three buckets: one‑time perpetual license (or multi‑year license), recurring platform fee (per site or per anchor node), and an SRE/ops retainer that covers on‑call and runbook exercises.
- Amortization: standard options are 24/36/48 months; we can front‑load discounts into the license for higher commit levels and smooth the platform fee.
- Discounts: for commitments in the $1M–$1.5M range we generally offer a 10–15% blended concession across license + platform fee; for $2M+ commits we can reach 18–25% depending on support tier and term.

Marissa — can you prepare a short term sheet with two scenarios (24m/36m) and include a 3‑tier SRE menu (Standard 24x5, Priority 24x7, Premier with cross‑team oncall + runbooks)? Irene — can you add typical SLA tables and any addenda required for air‑gapped installs?

I can be on the call Thursday afternoon if you'd like to review before sending to procurement.

Thanks,
Rishi
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Susan Huang <susan.huang@atlasmed.com>
Cc: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai, irene_choi@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 15:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Initial RFI + questions on private deployment pricing

Susan — attaching a short draft term sheet to give concrete numbers and tradeoffs. Highlights below and included in the sheet (Draft_Term_Sheet_AtlasMed.xlsx).

Scenario A (24m amortization) — Anchor pilot then scale
- Perpetual license (one‑time): $600,000 (can be amortized over 24m)
- Platform fee (recurring): $9,000/month per primary site for observability, control plane, and backups
- SRE retainer (Standard 24x5): $6,000/month; Priority 24x7: $12,500/month; Premier: $22,000/month
- Discounting: at $1.2M first‑year commit we can offer a 12% blended discount across license + platform fee for a 24m term.

Scenario B (36m amortization) — smoother cashflow
- Perpetual license: $700,000 (discount applied over longer term)
- Platform fee: $10,500/month per primary site (higher due to longer support horizon)
- Same SRE tiers; we can apply an additional 3% rebate on platform fee for a 36m commitment.

Notes / levers we typically use to get to a deeper discount: multi‑site commit, committed throughput/GPU units, and extended invoicing cadence.

Attachment: Draft_Term_Sheet_AtlasMed.xlsx (spreadsheet, 28KB)

Would be happy to hop on a call Thursday 3pm PT. Also attaching the SOC2 summary in my follow up (Irene will send the full evidence set via secure transfer).

Best,
Marissa Cole
Principal Commercials Manager
Redwood Inference

From: Susan Huang <susan.huang@atlasmed.com>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement@atlasmed.com
Date: Tue, 22 Jun 2027 09:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Initial RFI + questions on private deployment pricing

Marissa / Rishi — thanks for the quick draft. A few followups from procurement and architecture: 

- Procurement requests a line item for a "migration retainer" (one‑time) to cover initial on‑site onboarding — can you indicate what you usually charge and whether that is creditable against the SRE retainer?
- For discounting: we appreciate the blended 12% at $1.2M, but AtlasMed's internal target is 18% blended for initial year given regulatory budget constraints. If you can meet 16% and offer to amortize the platform fee across 36 months with a 30‑day invoice cadence, we'd have room to move.
- Architecture asks: do you support an optional limited‑audit HSM/KMS connector for key management (we'd like that in the SOW)? Also please confirm whether Premier SRE includes runbook creation and quarterly DR tabletop exercises.

Quoted for context: "Discounting: at $1.2M first‑year commit we can offer a 12% blended discount across license + platform fee for a 24m term."

If you can respond with a revised term table and a short SOW bullet list by EOD Tuesday we can prepare a procurement redline and aim for sign by the end of next week.

Regards,
Susan Huang
Director, Procurement, AtlasMed

From: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
To: Susan Huang <susan.huang@atlasmed.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, irene_choi@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 22 Jun 2027 15:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: AtlasMed — Private deployment commercial structure and SRE tiering

Susan — quick internal alignment and reply (looping our delivery lead Irene):

- Migration retainer: standard one‑time migration retainer is $45,000 for a two‑week on‑site engagement; fully creditable against the first three months of the SRE retainer (Standard or Priority) or against 50% of the first three months of Premier. We'll include that as a line item and a credit rule in the SOW.
- Discount counter: we can move to 16% blended at the $1.2M anchor if AtlasMed signs a 36m amortization schedule and commits to 30‑day invoices. To get to 18% we'd need a multi‑site commit or an increased first‑year threshold ($1.6M).
- KMS/HSM: we support a limited connector and will add a KMS addendum to the SOW; it'll be scoped as an optional engineering deliverable (timeline: 6–8 weeks, separate change order).
- Premier SRE: confirmed — Premier includes runbook creation, quarterly DR tabletops, a named escalation contact, and 4 prioritized incident drills per year.

Marissa / Irene — can you produce a revised two‑scenario term table (36m preferred for Rishi's counter) and a short SOW bullets list (migration retainer credit, KMS addendum, Premier deliverables) by EOD so Susan can circulate to procurement?
